newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 7.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 48.72 points to close at 6,526.07, inspired by a rally in high-technology shares.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index shed 15.73 points to 1,136.78. For the week, it fell 80.86 points or 6.64 percent, pressured by brokerages making cash calls on their clients and new lending curbs announced by Bank Negara.
* Tan Chong Motor announced a revision of the schemes of arrangement under the proposed rationalisation and demerger of its group operations.
* Olympia Industries said it had recieved a gaming licence from the Ministry of Finance for its operations in eastern Sabah state.
* Analysts said they expect a rebound on Monday as the market appears oversold. But buying would be cautious, they said.
